run_copy_detection_eval: run copy detection evaluation on the Copydays dataset using a pretrained DINO ViT model
extract_features_with_gem: extract ViT features using GeM pooling on patch tokens concatenated with the CLS token
create_copydays_dataset: create a CopydaysDataset instance to manage original, strong, JPEG quality, and crop image blocks
eval_copydays_results: evaluate copy detection results by computing mAP across all query blocks using average precision
compute_average_precision: compute the average precision score from a list of true positive ranks and total positives
